svg.title: Services page and host agents
svg.desc: The master's host service manager keeps the whitelists and confirmations and calls each node agent over mTLS; on Linux the agent controls containers through Docker and units through the root mirbadllm-hostd, on Windows through the SCM and on a Mac through hostd under launchd.
svg.text: discover every container · control whitelisted ones
systemd · root · Unix socket only, no TCP
deny list · unit whitelist · systemctl · nvidia-smi
Windows services through the Service Control Manager (SCM)
launchd jobs (Ollama, LM Studio, ComfyUI) through mirbadllm-hostd (launchd)
Only hostd runs systemctl, as root, and only for whitelisted units the deny list allows.
